title: Numbered forward-only .sql migrations apply one file one transaction; schema_version advances
asA: operator who needs deploys reproducible from a git ref with no schema state outside version control
iWant: every schema change to be a new numbered .sql file under the elicited migrations directory, applied by the in-tree runner one file at a time inside its own transaction
soThat: the schema shape at any deployed version can be read from committed files, each apply either commits or leaves the schema exactly as it was, and the schema_version bookkeeping table is the one source of truth on what has been applied

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a fresh Postgres database at schema_version 0 and three numbered forward-only .sql migration files (001, 002, 003), when the migration runner opens the store and applies them, then each file applies inside its own transaction (BEGIN, file body, COMMIT), a migrationsApplied event fires with the applied filename list, and the schema_version bookkeeping table records three rows keyed by filename.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh Postgres instance and a migrations directory with 001_*.sql, 002_*.sql, 003_*.sql each a single statement inside an implicit transaction
acceptanceCriteria.when: the migration runner applies the directory against the database
acceptanceCriteria.then: each file runs inside a BEGIN/COMMIT pair; after all three succeed a migrationsApplied event fires with the filename list ['001_*.sql', '002_*.sql', '003_*.sql'] and the schema_version table (or the runner's configured bookkeeping table name) carries a row per applied filename
